create_layer_drop_module_list: create a LayerDropModuleList with dropout probability p and a list of nn modules
build_layer_drop_with_layers: build a LayerDropModuleList that randomly drops transformer encoder layers during training with p=0.1
iterate_layer_drop_module_list: iterate over a LayerDropModuleList to apply only non-dropped layers to input tensor x
review_layer_drop_module_list_init: review the LayerDropModuleList __init__ to understand how dropout probability p is stored
review_layer_drop_module_list_iter: review the LayerDropModuleList __iter__ to understand how layers are randomly dropped during training
